description:
A recoverable GPU fault during a checkpointed hybrid sweep aborts the sweep resumably, while the uncheckpointed scheduler substitutes the CPU path. A deterministic fallback inside the checkpointed sweep needs the fault-injection modulus, which affects results, in the checkpoint identity.

## Background

`crates/gf2-sim/src/executor/drain.rs` propagates the fault because `inject_gpu_oom_modulus` is outside `snr_checkpoint::config_hash`, so a CPU-substituted resume would not be byte-identical. `@/inv/accelerator-safe-fallback` and `@/inv/deterministic-seeded-execution` both apply.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A recoverable GPU fault in a checkpointed sweep completes through the CPU path, and a resumed run reproduces the uninterrupted run's result columns byte for byte at a fixed seed, covered by a test.
- [hard] REQ-02: The checkpoint identity covers every input that affects which path decodes a frame; a checkpoint written under a different value is refused on resume, covered by a test.
- [hard] REQ-03: Existing checkpoints remain readable or are refused with an explicit error; the choice is recorded in the issue.
title: Deterministic CPU fallback for a recoverable GPU fault in a checkpointed sweep
